posts_7d.text: The gift for the woman who says she needs nothing: a gentle electric #toothbrush with ultra-soft bristles and a pressure sensor. #Menopause can bring gum sensitivity and a dry mouth, so gentle matters. #gifts #giftforher #holidayseason #giftideas

posts_7d.text: Gentle Vitamin A at night can fit a skin density routine once your barrier feels calm. Start slowly, and pause if your skin stings. #MenopauseSkin #SkinCare
